question.en: Discuss the role of National Investment and Manufacturing Zones (NIMZ) in achieving the 'Make in India' vision.
question.hi: Discuss the role of National Investment and Manufacturing Zones (NIMZ) in achieving the 'Make in India' vision.

modelAnswer.en: NIMZs provide plug-and-play infrastructure, reduce regulatory burden, and promote industrial clustering, which are essential for enhancing manufacturing competitiveness and job creation.
